job: Board game rules engine: gomoku, Reversi, Go, checkers

pitch.en: Play forty-eight abstract board games through immutable moves, legal choices and replayable records.
pitch.ja: 48種類の盤上ゲームを、新しい局面を返す手の操作、合法手の一覧、再生できる棋譜で扱えます。

name.en: Narabe means arranging in Japanese, as in gomoku-narabe: five in a row.
name.ja: 「並べ」は五目並べの「並べ」。石を並べることを表す言葉です。
